items.title: 14.9 Hawa ke mayar aur insani sehat ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9 heading, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Air quality aur insani sehat ka taalluq (link) achhi tarah sabit (well-documented) aur bohat aham hai. Kharab air quality ke sehat par fauri (immediate) aur lambe arse (long-term) ke asraat ho sakte hain. Bare pollutants aur un ke asraat 14.9.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Air pollution ke sehat par asraat 'fauri' aur 'lambe arse ke' dono kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada pollution wala ek din bhi foran aankhon aur saans ki naliyon mein jalan aur asthma ka attack la sakta hai, jabke saalon gandi hawa mein saans lene se aahista aahista bronchitis, dil ki bimari aur cancer ho sakte hain.

items: Kharab air quality ke sehat par fauri aur lambe arse ke asraat hote hain.
